title: 事故复盘：桌面端崩溃（误杀子进程）+ 弹窗根治（进程守护）+ 静默运行

incident.rootCause: killed two DeepSeek Harness.exe processes by raw PID (4508, 15672) that belonged to the desktop app process tree, not the superagent instance
incident.secondary: first version of ensure-superagent.ps1 had Chinese comments; PowerShell 5.1 parsed BOM-less UTF-8 as ANSI and failed with a syntax error, so the watchdog could not restart the instance for ~15 minutes
incident.recovery: desktop app auto-restarted at 12:43 (new main pid 30676); superagent recovered at 12:49 via recover-superagent.ps1

popupRootCause.explanation: old ensure script probed only the API; a transient API outage (in-place restart after a settings save) was mistaken for a crash, so a second instance was launched, failed to take the lock, and its Electron window flashed an error
popupRootCause.fix: process guard: any existing 'profile superagent' process means exit without launching
popupRootCause.evidence: ensure.log 12:50:31 'instance already running (pids: 29000,23856); nothing to do'

changes: E:\dsh-state\ensure-superagent.ps1 rewritten: ASCII-only, process guard, API probe, 60s window-hiding loop, logging
E:\dsh-state\run-hidden.vbs added (wscript hidden launcher, no console flash)
E:\dsh-state\recover-superagent.ps1 added (kill -> clear lock -> single hidden start -> verify)
scheduled tasks DSH Superagent / DSH Superagent Watchdog switched to wscript.exe //B //Nologo run-hidden.vbs

desktopGui.windowTitle: Super-agent 设计探索解读 — DeepSeek Harness

lessons: never kill DeepSeek Harness.exe by raw PID; match the command line 'profile superagent'
PowerShell 5.1 scripts must stay ASCII-only (BOM-less UTF-8 is read as ANSI)
after changing a launcher or scheduled task, verify with logs + process count + window visibility
